import pytest
import re

from inflection import (
    camelize,
    dasherize,
    humanize,
    ordinal,
    ordinalize,
    parameterize,
    pluralize,
    singularize,
    tableize,
    titleize,
    transliterate,
    underscore,
    UNCOUNTABLES,
)


def test_camelize_lowercase_first_letter_empty():
    # empty string with uppercase_first_letter=False triggers IndexError
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        camelize("", uppercase_first_letter=False)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# dasherize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "word,expected",
    [
        ("puni_puni", "puni-puni"),
        ("nochange", "nochange"),
        ("multiple_under_scores_here", "multiple-under-scores-here"),
        ("", ""),
    ],
)
def test_dasherize(word, expected):
    assert dasherize(word) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# humanize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "word,expected",
    [
        ("employee_salary", "Employee salary"),
        ("author_id", "Author"),
        ("multiple_words_here", "Multiple words here"),
        ("alreadyHumanized", "Alreadyhumanized"),
        ("", ""),
    ],
)
def test_humanize(word, expected):
    assert humanize(word) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# ordinal
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "number,expected",
    [
        (1, "st"),
        (2, "nd"),
        (3, "rd"),
        (4, "th"),
        (11, "th"),
        (12, "th"),
        (13, "th"),
        (21, "st"),
        (22, "nd"),
        (23, "rd"),
        (111, "th"),
        (0, "th"),
        (-1, "st"),
        (-11, "th"),
        (-1021, "st"),
    ],
)
def test_ordinal(number, expected):
    assert ordinal(number) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# ordinalize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "number,expected",
    [
        (1, "1st"),
        (2, "2nd"),
        (3, "3rd"),
        (4, "4th"),
        (11, "11th"),
        (12, "12th"),
        (13, "13th"),
        (21, "21st"),
        (-1, "-1st"),
        (-11, "-11th"),
        (0, "0th"),
    ],
)
def test_ordinalize(number, expected):
    assert ordinalize(number) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# parameterize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_parameterize_basic():
    assert parameterize("Donald E. Knuth") == "donald-e-knuth"


def test_parameterize_custom_separator():
    assert parameterize("Donald E. Knuth", separator="_") == "donald_e_knuth"


def test_parameterize_collapsing_and_trimming():
    # leading/trailing punctuation and multiple spaces become a single separator
    assert parameterize("  Hello!!  ") == "hello"


def test_parameterize_non_ascii():
    # non‑ASCII characters are transliterated then processed
    assert parameterize("Ærøskøbing") == "rskbing"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# pluralize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "word,expected",
    [
        ("post", "posts"),
        ("octopus", "octopi"),
        ("sheep", "sheep"),
        ("Person", "People"),
        ("person", "people"),
        ("", ""),
        ("xyz", "xyzs"),  # default rule adds 's'
    ],
)
def test_pluralize(word, expected):
    assert pluralize(word) == expected


def test_pluralize_uncountable_case_insensitive():
    for w in ["Fish", "fish", "FISH"]:
        assert pluralize(w) == w


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# singularize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "word,expected",
    [
        ("posts", "post"),
        ("octopi", "octopus"),
        ("sheep", "sheep"),
        ("People", "Person"),
        ("people", "person"),
        ("", ""),
        ("xyzs", "xyz"),
    ],
)
def test_singularize(word, expected):
    assert singularize(word) == expected


def test_singularize_uncountable_case_insensitive():
    for w in ["Series", "series", "SERIES"]:
        assert singularize(w) == w


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# tableize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_tableize_camelcase():
    assert tableize("RawScaledScorer") == "raw_scaled_scorers"


def test_tableize_with_underscores():
    assert tableize("egg_and_ham") == "egg_and_hams"


def test_tableize_mixed():
    assert tableize("FancyCategory") == "fancy_categories"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# titleize
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "input_str,expected",
    [
        ("man from the boondocks", "Man From The Boondocks"),
        ("x-men: the last stand", "X Men: The Last Stand"),
        ("TheManWithoutAPast", "The Man Without A Past"),
        ("raiders_of_the_lost_ark", "Raiders Of The Lost Ark"),
        ("", ""),
    ],
)
def test_titleize(input_str, expected):
    assert titleize(input_str) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# transliterate
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "src,expected",
    [
        ("älämölö", "alamolo"),
        ("Ærøskøbing", "rskbing"),
        ("ñáéíóú", "naeiou"),
        ("", ""),
    ],
)
def test_transliterate(src, expected):
    assert transliterate(src) == expected


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# underscore
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "word,expected",
    [
        ("DeviceType", "device_type"),
        ("IOError", "io_error"),
        ("MyClassName", "my_class_name"),
        ("my-class", "my_class"),
        ("", ""),
    ],
)
def test_underscore(word, expected):
    assert underscore(word) == expected
